items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: I got to play with Eddie Durham, Eddie Barefield.

ctx.x: I thought of that yesterday when I had this recording of him doing “Stars Fell on Alabama” [scats] just like Johnny Hodges.

Well you know where he got that from, right, of course. That’s right, all those guys. Yeah, so I mean I’ve been really lucky. I got to New York right when some of those guys were still around, so I got to play with Eddie Durham, Eddie Barefield.
